research_question: Can a recursive, typed constant representation remove SourceIndexV0 process identity and hash-order nondeterminism without weakening callable coverage or mutation invalidation?
claim_boundary: Targeted posthoc repair of the P3b cross-process counterexample on 11 known units plus synthetic constant fixtures. This does not repair HistogramMatching replay capability and is not blind evidence.

root_causes: repr(code.co_consts) embeds nested code-object memory addresses
repr(frozenset) order varies with hash randomization

candidate_policy.separate_module: Implement SourceIndexV1 as a new candidate module; do not edit SourceIndexV0 or any P3b artifact.
typed_constants: None, bool, int and str by typed value
float by hex form with explicit NaN and infinity tags
frozenset recursively then sort by canonical JSON
Ellipsis and NotImplemented by explicit tags
nested code objects by bytecode digest, argument/flag metadata, names/varnames/freevars/cellvars and recursively canonical constants
excluded_identity: first line number and line table
candidate_policy.unknown_constant: Any unsupported constant type makes the callable/index Unknown; its repr is not admitted as a fallback.
candidate_policy.hot_sentinel: Unchanged SourceIndexV0 hot sentinel; P3c only changes deployment-time portable representation.

evaluation.real_units: The exact 11 P3b factory/configuration/component-slot bundles under the same isolated runtime.
evaluation.v0_v1_comparison: Report status and entry count per component; V1 must not silently drop a V0 entry.
synthetic_fixtures: nested list-comprehension code object is cross-process stable
frozenset constant is stable across hash seeds
format/comment-only and docstring-only changes preserve digest
executable AST, default, closure, referenced global, wrapper and origin changes alter digest

primary_metrics: V1 Supported/Unknown and entry-count parity on 11 units
portable mutation Reject/Unknown/Admit and baseline restoration
index bytes and cold construction time versus V0
success_gates: all 11 V1 bundles retain complete registered-component coverage
V1 status is Supported for all 11 units and no V0 entry is dropped
V1 digest is stable 11/11 within process and across both fresh hash-seeded processes
all 22 delegating-wrapper mutations are Reject, all 11 native overrides are Unknown, and none are Admit
all 33 mutations restore the exact baseline digest/status
no P3b, SourceIndexV0, framework source, runtime manifest or lock artifact changes
falsification_rules: Deleting constants from the index is not a valid portability fix.
Replacing code-object repr with only outer bytecode is invalid because nested executable semantics would be unbound.
A digest stable under one default hash seed is insufficient; both registered fresh hash-seeded processes must match.
Raw digest drift under Unknown is not a Reject decision.
Any HistogramMatching replay result remains the P3b failure and is outside P3c's repair scope.
If V1 fails, retain the result and create a new protocol before changing canonicalization policy.
